newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Target says finds gold signs in Malaysia. [CORRECTED 10:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Target says finds gold signs in Malaysia. [CORRECTED 10:00 GMT]

text.p: Target Mining Corp Ltd said on Monday exploration work had delineated additional mineralisation to the south of its Selinsing gold mine project in Malaysia's Pahang state.
(Corrects country in headline and first paragraph from Indonesia)

Selinsing currently has a gold resource base of 325,400 ounces, although infill drilling could lift the resource estimate a further 45,000 ounces to 60,000 ounces, Target managing director Peter Kestel said in a statement.
Kestel said a further upgrade of Selinsing was likely after drilling at the southern extension of the project yielded 18 metres grading 2.6 grams of gold per tonne of ore.
